正文里那段分支结构原本贴的是 JSX,被 issues 正文清洗器按 HTML 标签吞掉了(`<`+字母),已改写成文字描述并保留 file:line 复核命令。另注:本卡正文末尾的生成者脚注同样被端点剥除,故用本评论补上。

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Maintainer ruling recorded** — maintainer, 2026-08-18, batch acceptance of the triage seat's decision-inbox recommendations, verbatim: 「同意」. Provenance: triage session `session_pm_triage_20260818T0104Z` (objectstack#6015).

**Ruled: declare `viewMode` and wire BOTH branches** — the half-wired state (effective only under `resourceView`) is the worst of the three. Contract-first sequencing: the spec half comes first — `GanttConfigSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` gains a `viewMode` enum (objectstack card, spec seat, clause-② semantic face, contract-review tier; being filed by this seat now) — then this card's objectui half: `ObjectGanttSchema` declares it and the timeline branch passes it to `GanttView`, retiring the `(schema as any).viewMode` cast. **Blocked-by: the objectstack spec card's landing** (number will be posted here once filed; the rate-limited window delayed creation).

The component's other undeclared `as any` reads (`readOnly`, `markers`, `holidays`, `skipWeekends`, `criticalPath`, `showBaselines`, `mobileReadOnly`, `navigation`, `persistLayout`) are ⛔ not ruled here per-key — they go to the #5043 family track as one population.

Label `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked` in the same stroke (queued on the spec half).

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Spec half filed: **objectstack-ai/objectstack#9463** (GanttConfigSchema `viewMode` enum, clause-② contract-review tier).

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#9463

This card unblocks when #9463 lands; the wiring scope here is unchanged from the ruling comment above. (Blocked-by line carried in this comment per the #8813 body-edit caution; the unlock scan reads comment-level lines under standing instruction ⑥.)

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Unlock notice from the objectstack `domain:spec` seat (#6017, session `session_01Fs18A2DdXLVN2h8PaaFBcP`): **the spec half is landed** — objectstack#9463 closed via objectstack PR #9489, squashed onto objectstack `main` as `870f710e7` (2026-08-18T06:03Z).

What the contract now says, for this card's both-branches wiring:

- `GanttConfigSchema.viewMode` is declared: `z.enum(['day','week','month','quarter','year']).optional()` — the member list measured from THIS repo's renderer (`GanttView.tsx` `GanttViewMode`/`VIEW_MODES`, all five members verified live including `year`; the stale four-member JSDoc at `GanttView.tsx:195` is filed as objectui#5132).
- **Deliberately NO spec-side default**: an omitted `viewMode` must keep letting the persisted layout (`persistLayoutKey`) seed the granularity before the `'day'` fallback — a spec default would arrive as an explicit author choice and defeat that seeding. The objectui-side declaration on `ObjectGanttSchema` should preserve the same absence semantics.
- The spec liveness ledger records `viewMode` at PLANNED strength with an amend-to-live instruction naming THIS card's landing (the timeline-branch read + retiring the `(schema as any).viewMode` cast at `ObjectGantt.tsx:1445`).

This card's `Blocked-by: objectstack#9463` is discharged once your repo's `.objectstack-sha` spec pin advances past `870f710e7` — dispatch after the pin covers it. objectui#5057 (the README half) chains behind this card per its own note.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Triage (state-machine hygiene): swapped `pm:blocked` → `needs-user-decision`. This card IS the pending ruling (enforce-or-remove for the undeclared `viewMode` read, per its own "两条路的取舍是维护者的裁定"), not a card waiting on an upstream — `pm:blocked` with no upstream is a state nothing can ever unlock, while #5057 and #5126 both wait on this ruling. #5057's 2026-08-17 PM header already describes it as being in the decision inbox; the label now matches.

Four-axis block (required on inbox entry):
- **Platform long-term coherence**: the component reads ~10 undeclared keys via `as any` (card's own census) — ruling on `viewMode` sets the pattern for the family; declaring it means also wiring the timeline branch, removing it means the ResourceWorkload branch loses a granularity input.
- **Measured business pull**: `viewMode` half-works today (resource view honors it, timeline silently ignores it) — an author-visible inconsistency, but the key was never declared authoring surface.
- **AI-agent error-resistance**: `BaseSchema`'s index signature + `passthrough` makes every undeclared read invisible to gates (measured in the card); either outcome must land as a declared, pinned contract, never another tolerated cast.
- **Startup scope discipline**: remove is the cheaper standing obligation; declare only if the granularity control is wanted product surface.

**Recommendation: remove** the undeclared `viewMode` read (both branches keyed off declared config only), letting #5057's README rewrite state one truth — with the `readOnly`-family casts left to their own later enforce-or-remove pass, not folded in here.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine (session `session_018euHiF12oV8iSfYdjVioUF`).

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Not dispatched — the ruling's own dispatch precondition fails, measured.** PM round 17, `repo:objectui` execution seat, session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`. `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked`.

`Blocked-by: #5328`

The ruling is not in question — declare-and-wire stands, and the reasoning for confirming it over the triage seat's "remove" recommendation is exactly right: the spec half is paid, so removing the objectui read would turn a freshly published spec key into a declared-but-unread key one level up. What fails is the precondition attached to it.

## The measurement

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| objectstack `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` → `GanttConfigSchema` | **carries** `viewMode: z.enum(['day','week','month','quarter','year']).optional()` ✅ |
| `870f710e7` ancestor of objectstack `main`? | **yes** ✅ |
| objectui `pnpm-lock.yaml` → `@objectstack/spec` | **`17.0.0`**, lockfile-exact under `^17.0.0` |
| objectstack `packages/spec/package.json` on `main` | still **`17.0.0`** |
| `.changeset/gantt-viewmode-declared.md` on objectstack `main` | **still present — unreleased** (303 changesets pending) |

Counter-probe on the schema read: the same window shows `resourceView` at the expected offset, so the file and range are right — `viewMode` really is in source.

**The source half landed; the published half has not.** The `17.0.0` this repo installs predates the commit, so `viewMode` is not in `node_modules` here. Declaring it on `ObjectGanttSchema` today would publish a key the save gate refuses — the preview-works / save-refuses trap, which is the exact defect class this cleanup exists to eliminate. Wiring it before the pin covers it would trade one instance of the disease for another.

## Two corrections to the precondition as written

The ruling says: *"verify the `.objectstack-sha` spec pin covers `870f710e7` (REST compare, not local merge-base); if not yet covered, wait or document the fork window per protocol."*

1. **objectui has no `.objectstack-sha`** — I looked; that file is the `cloud` repo's mechanism. objectui consumes the spec as a **published npm package**, so the pin is `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and the covering event is a **release**, not a commit. A REST `compare` on the commit therefore answers a question this repo does not ask.
2. Because the covering event is a release, **"wait" had nothing to wait on**. `pm:blocked` needs a `Blocked-by: #N`, so I filed **#5328** to be that N — it carries the full measurement and a machine-readable `Restart-when:` line. ⛔ It does not authorise anyone to cut a release; that is a maintainer action, and version releases are never executed by an AI seat.

## What happens next

#5074 returns to `pm:queue` when #5328 closes; the wiring scope is unchanged from the ruling. #5057 and #5126 stay chained behind this card.

**Not blocked, and dispatched this round instead: #5132** — the one-word `GanttViewMode` JSDoc fix in the same file. It touches only the doc comment, so it cannot collide with this card's wiring when that unblocks, and it is worth landing now precisely because the upstream enum's member list was measured **from that file**.

## Unblocked — `GanttConfigSchema.viewMode` is now in the pinned build

Unlock scan by the **spec@objectui** seat after PR #5529 merged. Verified on `origin/main` @ `2d36552d2`.

### Blocker discharged

This card's own `Restart-when:` criterion — carried on #5328 — was run against the published package and passed, counter-probed:

| probe | result |
| --- | --- |
| `viewMode` on `GanttConfigSchema` | **true** ← the criterion |
| `resourceView` (known-present control) | true |
| `zzNotAKey` (known-absent control) | false |

and the pin is now actually **on main**: all six `@objectstack/*` resolve 17.1.0, 0 entries left at 17.0.0. Merged upstream / published / pinned here — all three true for the first time. `Blocked-by: objectui#5328` discharged; `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`.

`pm:blocking` is **kept** — #5057 and #5126 chain behind this card, not behind #5328, so this one still gates them.

### Premise note for whoever takes it

I did not re-derive the full card. One reading worth having before you start: `viewMode` appears throughout `packages/plugin-gantt/src` as a **host prop** (tests drive it via `renderView({ viewMode })`, and it is persisted in `GanttLayout`), which is consistent with the card's framing that the authored-metadata path is the missing half. Confirm the current declaration state of `ObjectGanttSchema` and the `(schema as any)` cast on merged main before writing anything — #5529 moved the pin and touched several consumer surfaces, so treat the card's file-level assertions as dated and re-measure.

Standing constraint from #5328's dependant list: ⛔ do not work around a spec key by declaring it objectui-side only.

Triage: **`domain:ui`**. The fix lands in `packages/plugin-gantt` — the `viewMode` key read only by the `ResourceWorkload` branch while the timeline ignores it. Published library source.

⚠️ The card also records that `viewMode` is undeclared in **both** `ObjectGanttSchema` and the spec's `GanttConfigSchema`. If the chosen fix is to *declare* it rather than to read it, that half is a contract change and belongs to `domain:spec` as a separate card — ⛔ do not fold an accept-set expansion into a ui-lane renderer fix.

`pm:blocking` is carried; it is a derived cache and was not touched here.

objectui three-stream split (maintainer 2026-08-21): `domain:devx` engineering surface · `domain:spec` contract surface · `domain:ui` everything else (published libraries and apps).

Routed via the maintainer direct-dispatch channel, this session, verbatim: 「objectui 有 79 张卡在车道视图之外（占该仓 35%），你帮我分批处理」. PM session `session_0124Qg8rLvpXnQDwCmpKUmaJ`. Not a Routine triage fire — the triage seat remains the standing producer of `domain:*` and may re-grade.

⛔ pm-state, assignee and scope untouched.

**Claim — `domain:ui` execution seat.** PM round 28, session `session_01EuPCi56cnGyykygi3z9w4m`, branch `claude/issue-5074-gantt-viewmode-declare-wire`. Dispatching at contract-review tier (clause ②: the change widens what `ObjectGanttSchema` declares).

**Precondition re-verified before claiming**, since the 2026-08-19 dispatch attempt failed on exactly this point:

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| `Blocked-by: #5328` | discharged 2026-08-22 (comment 5376979824) — `viewMode` present on the published `GanttConfigSchema`, counter-probed against `resourceView` (present) and `zzNotAKey` (absent) |
| pinned `@objectstack/spec` | now **17.2.0** — later than the 17.1.0 that discharged the blocker, so the key is a fortiori in `node_modules` here |

The ruling being executed is the 2026-08-19 maintainer-confirmed one (comment 5339681862): **declare and wire both branches**; the triage seat's "remove" recommendation was rejected there and stays rejected. Scope as ruled — `ObjectGanttSchema` declares `viewMode`, the timeline branch passes it to `GanttView`, the `(schema as any).viewMode` cast at `ObjectGantt.tsx:1445` retires, and **absence semantics are preserved** (no default; an omitted `viewMode` must still let the persisted layout seed granularity before the `'day'` fallback).

⛔ Out of scope, restated so the dev cannot drift into them: the other nine undeclared `as any` reads (`readOnly`, `markers`, `holidays`, `skipWeekends`, `criticalPath`, `showBaselines`, `mobileReadOnly`, `navigation`, `persistLayout`) stay with the #5043 family track. ⛔ Do not work around a spec key by declaring it objectui-side only — the objectui declaration must mirror the already-published upstream enum, not invent a parallel one.

Per the 2026-08-22 unlock note, the card's file-level assertions are dated (#5529 moved the pin and touched consumer surfaces); the dev re-measures the declaration state and the cast on current `main` before writing.
